images.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: square character portrait for CELLWATCH, a digital hospital network inspection game inspired by the document-comparison gameplay of Papers, Please, but original visual identity. Create ONE original character, a small anthropomorphic hospital DATA COURIER ROBOT representing an authentication-key forwarding request. Incident 01: reception authentication courier, gray-blue enamel shell, rounded square monitor face with two expressive cyan eyes, teal hospital utility jacket, holding a key-token device and a tiny routing parcel. Its blank destination badge is detached and mismatched; slightly evasive posture, subtle amber status light, but not an obvious villain. This is a digital packet personification, not a real patient or doctor. Bust/waist-up, 3/4 front facing, strong readable silhouette, centered with generous 12% margin, dark navy solid background #112129 filling the entire square. Sophisticated hand-painted 2D game character art, graphic shapes, textured brush shading, crisp edges, restrained teal/ivory/amber palette, warm human expression, no photorealism, no pixel art. Consistent compact portrait composition suitable at 150px. No words, letters, numbers, logos, red cross emblem, gore, weapons or watermarks.
